analysis_role: Post-result mechanism-discrimination boundary test. Without adding new climate variables, ask whether the primary BIO15 orientation correspondence retains information after conditioning on the already-frozen BIO1 axis and coarse geography, and whether the same direction appears in phylogenetically matched opposite-state taxon pairs.

A_conditional_specificity.primary_model: Brownian GLS z(BIO15) ~ orientation + z(BIO1) + z(latitude) + z(longitude)
A_conditional_specificity.reverse_model: Brownian GLS z(BIO1) ~ orientation + z(BIO15) + z(latitude) + z(longitude)
A_conditional_specificity.robustness: species leave-one-out on every accepted topology
A_conditional_specificity.primary_direction_retained: orientation coefficient positive in 6/6 topologies and all 54 species-LOO fits
A_conditional_specificity.reverse_direction_retained: orientation coefficient negative in 6/6 topologies and all 54 species-LOO fits
A_conditional_specificity.interpretation: Retention of BIO15 after conditioning on BIO1 and geography strengthens environmental-axis specificity but remains observational and non-causal.

B_incremental_prediction.baseline: Brownian conditional prediction with intercept + z(BIO1) + z(latitude) + z(longitude)
B_incremental_prediction.evaluation: leave one taxon out for each of six accepted topologies
B_incremental_prediction.sign_rule: positive improvement means orientation adds held-out BIO15 predictive information beyond the frozen competing climate axis, geography and phylogenetic covariance
B_incremental_prediction.role: supporting diagnostic; not required for causal classification

C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.full_panel: For each topology, pair all four D taxa one-to-one with four of five U taxa by exact minimum-total patristic distance; no taxon reuse; deterministic lexicographic tie break.
C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.japan_only: Repeat after excluding Taiwan: pair all three Japan D taxa one-to-one with three of four Japan U taxa by the same rule.
C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.environmental_contrast: For every matched pair compute D minus U difference in panel-standardized BIO15 and BIO1 centroids.
C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.primary_summary: number of positive BIO15 pair contrasts, median BIO15 pair contrast, and whether all matched BIO15 contrasts are positive on each topology
C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.secondary_summary: analogous BIO1 contrasts in the prespecified negative D-minus-U direction
C_phylogenetic_opposite_state_matching.boundary: Topology-specific matched pairs are sensitivity constructions, not independent evolutionary transitions or biological replicates.

claim_ceiling: No result establishes precipitation seasonality as a selective agent or historical cause.
No result establishes a hydric mechanism, adaptation or plasticity.
BIO15 and BIO1 are present-day climate summaries and may remain correlated with unmeasured geography or lineage properties.
Matched extant taxon pairs are not reconstructed independent transitions.
Accepted topology realizations are sensitivity analyses, not independent biological replicates.
No additional environmental predictor may be added after result inspection.
